root_cause.text: In btrfs transaction commit with EXTENT_TREE_V2, btrfs_commit_transaction() incorrectly treated block_group_root like a special switch_commit root and added its dirty_list to switch_commits even though block_group_root already uses normal dirty root tracking, causing the same list_head to be inserted into multiple lists and corrupting the list links.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the EXTENT_TREE_V2 block that did `list_add_tail(&fs_info->block_group_root->dirty_list, &cur_trans->switch_commits);`, and the commit message explicitly says “the block group tree uses normal root dirty tracking,” “the block group root will already be linked to a list by the dirty_list field,” and this extra `list_add_tail()` “is invalid and corrupts the prev/next members of block_group_root->dirty_list.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Stop updating and switch-committing the block group root during transaction commit for EXTENT_TREE_V2 in this code path.
intent_record.what: The change removes a conditional block in btrfs_commit_transaction() that, when EXTENT_TREE_V2 was enabled, updated block_group_root->root_item with block_group_root->node via btrfs_set_root_node() and added fs_info->block_group_root->dirty_list to cur_trans->switch_commits.
intent_record.how: At runtime, transactions no longer explicitly mark the block group root for switch-commit processing or refresh its root node in this path when EXTENT_TREE_V2 is active, preventing that extra commit-time handling from occurring here.

grouping_result.intent: Stop updating and switch-committing the block group root during transaction commit for EXTENT_TREE_V2 in this code path.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly removes special switch-commit handling of block_group_root in the transaction commit path for EXTENT_TREE_V2, which matches the root cause of incorrectly treating block_group_root like a switch_commit root and corrupting dirty_list links.

The provided function body for `btrfs_commit_transaction()` is sufficient because the root cause is specifically about how this function classifies roots and manipulates `dirty_list`/`switch_commits`. In this commit version, the function still contains the old special-root handling without any exclusion for `block_group_root`. The relevant code is:

There is no check here excluding `block_group_root`, nor any conditional handling based on EXTENT_TREE_V2. Therefore the vulnerable construct is present.

The fix is not present because there is no added condition preventing `block_group_root` from being handled like a switch-commit root, and no special-case logic for EXTENT_TREE_V2/block-group tree roots appears in this function.
